name: open Add Games
js: location.hash = '#SRM/preview'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); return location.hash

name: generate
js: const c = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('preview')); c.generatePreviewData(); const v = c.previewService.getPreviewVariables(); const t = Date.now(); while ((!v.listHasGenerated || v.listIsBeingGenerated || v.numberOfQueriedImages) && Date.now() - t < 90000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); return { items: v.numberOfListItems, pending: v.numberOfQueriedImages, titles: Object.values(Object.values(Object.values(c.previewService.getPreviewData())[0])[0].apps).map(a => a.title) }

name: shown in UI
js: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return document.querySelector('preview').innerText.match(/Super Mario World|Chrono Trigger/g)

name: remove from Steam
js: const c = ng.getComponent(document.querySelector('preview')); await c.remove(); return c.previewService.getPreviewData() === undefined
